Patient Alex Rivera presents for follow-up of rheumatoid arthritis. Documented diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis confirmed by rheumatology in 2023 with RF and anti-CCP positivity. The patient had an inadequate response to methotrexate for at least 3 months at 20 mg weekly with persistent synovitis. Quantiferon-TB Gold was negative; negative TB screening within past 12 months is on file. Therapy is prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist, Dr. Sam Patel. Plan: initiate adalimumab 40 mg every other week.
